# nginxproxymanager_default_site (Resource)

What NPM shows when nginx is hit with a host it doesn't know. There is only one of these, so only declare it once. Destroying it resets NPM to the congratulations page.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Redirect requests for hosts NPM doesn't know
resource "nginxproxymanager_default_site" "example" {
  page     = "redirect"
  redirect = "https://www.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `page` (String) What to show: `congratulations` (the NPM default page), `404` (a not found page), `444` (close the connection), `redirect` (redirect to `redirect`) or `html` (show `html`).

### Optional

- `html` (String) HTML to show, when `page` is `html`.
- `redirect` (String) URL to redirect to, when `page` is `redirect`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `default-site`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# There is only one default site, which is always imported with this ID
terraform import nginxproxymanager_default_site.example default-site
```
